messages.subject: [Bioc-devel] Can the BBS send a single stateful "Fixed" or "Succeeded" message?
messages.subject_clean: [Bioc-devel] Can the BBS send a single stateful "Fixed" or "Succeeded" message?
messages.body_plain:
Hello Bioconductors,

One of the things I like about the GitLab CI system is that it tells you 
whether your last commit fixed a previous build failure.  Currently, the 
Bioconductor Build System will complain about errors and is silent when 
a build succeeds.  This delays the amount of time involved when one 
would backport a patch from devel to a corresponding failing release 
build.  An e-mail from BBS-noreply@[...] or RSS/Atom feed message is 
helpful because build times are approximate.

It would be great if the build system was stateful and can send a 
message if that last build failed and then had:
1) "Fixed" after a commit you made.
2) "Succeeded" in general (for example, from fixes in dependencies being 
updated / propagated).

Pariksheet

-- 
Pariksheet Nanda, PhD
Postdoctoral Associate
Shoemaker Laboratory
Department of Chemical Engineering
University of Pittsburgh

messages.subject: [Bioc-devel] Error in lazy loading for packages CSOA, GSABenchmark, hammers and scLang
messages.subject_clean: [Bioc-devel] Error in lazy loading for packages CSOA, GSABenchmark, hammers and scLang
messages.body_plain:
Dear Bioconductor team,

I am the maintainer of packages CSOA, GSABenchmark, hammers and scLang. I am contacting you about the following error:

Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) :
unable to load shared object '/home/biocbuild/bbs-3.24-bioc/R/site-library/qs2/libs/qs2.so':
/home/biocbuild/bbs-3.24-bioc/R/site-library/qs2/libs/qs2.so: undefined symbol: _ZTIN3tbb4taskE
Calls: ... asNamespace -> loadNamespace -> library.dynam -> dyn.load
Execution halted
ERROR: lazy loading failed for package ?CSOA?

This error appears for all my four Bioconductor packages, as well as for other packages which import or suggest qs2 (ChromSCape, cTRAP, gDRimport, gDRutils etc.).

I asked about the issue, and it seems it's not a qs2 issue but a RcppParallel one (see discussion here: https://github.com/qsbase/qs2/issues/30). I received the suggestion that you should rebuild qs2 using the latest version of RcppParallel (https://github.com/RcppCore/RcppParallel/issues/277). Please could you try this fix?

Best,
Andrei

messages.subject: [Bioc-devel] BiocAsia 2026 Call for Workshop proposals closes soon (21 Aug 2026)
messages.subject_clean: [Bioc-devel] BiocAsia 2026 Call for Workshop proposals closes soon (21 Aug 2026)
messages.body_plain:
Dear Bioconductor community,
The ABACBS 2026 Organising Committee, in collaboration with the BiocAsia 2026 Organising Committee, invites proposals for specialised workshops to be held in conjunction with the annual conference which will take place on 19-20 November 2026 in Melbourne, Australia, and the call for workshop proposals closes soon.
Workshops are a core, highly popular feature of the ABACBS annual meeting. They provide an opportunity for researchers, industry experts, and educators to share technical expertise, introduce novel software/tools, and lead practical, hands-on sessions for the community. Submissions covering a diverse range of foundational and cutting-edge topics are encouraged, including but not limited to:

  1.  Long-read sequencing
  2.  High-throughput sequencing data analysis
  3.  Single-cell and spatial omics
  4.  Microbiome and metagenomics
  5.  Scalable and reproducible workflows
  6.  Compute infrastructure and cloud computing
  7.  Machine learning and AI in genomics

Workshop Format
Dates: 19 November 2026 (Afternoon Session) and 20 November 2026 (Full Day)
Duration: Proposals can be for 1.5 hour short sessions, half-day sessions (approx. 3 hours excluding breaks) or full-day sessions (approx. 6 hours excluding breaks).
Delivery Mode: In-person / Online
Target Audience: Content can range from introductory (beginner) to advanced technical levels. Please explicitly state any prerequisites beforehand.
More information<https://www.abacbs.org/workshops-2026-call>
Submit your proposal here<https://forms.cloud.microsoft/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=cTYy0b7NF0S01L2yS1Exa4VCOrzaKWBOp_QKuwCkqSRUM09OTEhXSE85RUVCOEFTRzNBR1NMQlY0Ry4u&route=shorturl>

Best regards,
Laurah Ondari
Bioconductor Community Engagement Support
Bioinformatician, International Institute of Tropical Agriculture (IITA)
